victory.primary: Acquire and stash 6 Treasure or Dragon Gem tokens to break curse.

setup.tokens: Action die, Action cubes, Stat tokens light-gray near board

turn-summary.end: End when out of Movement or Action cubes, or choose to do nothing. Remove all Action cubes at end of turn.

statistics.movement: Tiles you can move onto this turn.
statistics.thievery: Number of Action cubes per turn.
statistics.rule-assign: Place one Stat token each on Movement, Stealth, Thievery; Action cubes = Thievery value.

role.treasure-shortage: If Thief ever needs to take a Treasure token from Cave supply and none are available, Thief may take one from anywhere on the map.

movement-rules.rule: Enter Lit and Dark; enter occupied tiles. Cannot cross walls or impassable terrain without Climb.
Ended movement on Dark: may peek at tile and may reveal (orient as you choose). Ambush on reveal: Goblins do not attack you or Knight later.
Target each other player once per turn with actions. Target only if Stealth > target's relevant defense stat.

target.stat: always targetable by relevant Thief effects

action.rule: Collect one Treasure or Dragon Gem on your space.
action.one-cube: Take Treasure or Gem. If Gem, roll Dragon die; center kills you.

action.rule: Steal from player on your space. 1 cube: roll 4+; 2 cubes: 2+; 3 cubes: auto.
action.upgrade: Sticky Fingers: once per turn reroll Pickpocket.
action.success: Treasure from Cave; Knight Treasure card to bottom or random; Goblin Secrets card; Dragon Sloth Wakefulness→Greed.
action.clarification: If stealing a revealed item, Thief chooses it; otherwise choose randomly. Treasure Trove is an exception handled by its own card text.
Thief cannot target Knight if she has no Treasures, Goblins if they have no takeable Secrets, or Dragon if no Sloth cube can move from Wakefulness to Greed.

action.rule: Vault on space. 1 cube: 4+; 2 cubes: 2+; 3 cubes: auto.
action.upgrade: Lock Picking Kit: −1 Action cube cost.
action.success: Remove Vault; Treasure from Cave supply.
action.clarification: A successful Pick Lock grants the Treasure immediately; Thief does not spend an additional Loot action on that newly opened Vault.

action.rule: 2 cubes: through wall. 3 cubes: impassable terrain, not ending on it.
action.clarification: Climb changes what movement is legal, but it does not reduce the Movement cost of making that move.

action.rule: Injure player on space. 1 Light; 2 Moderate; 3 Heavy.
action.upgrade: Hand Crossbow: visible player up to 3 spaces.

action.rule: X cubes: reduce Loot Drop Level by X.

interacting-with-others.rule: Knight/Goblins target you: their Perception > your Stealth.
Dragon and Cave always target you.
You Pickpocket/Backstab Knight/Goblins: your Stealth > their Perception.
You Pickpocket/Backstab Dragon: Stealth > Dragon Armor.
If another player attacks you, you are killed.

carrying-and-stashing.rule: Acquired tokens on Unstashed space; carry to Entrance to stash.
Enter Entrance: after effects, stash all.
Stash Gem: return to Dragon; take Treasure from Cave to stash.
Stash Treasure: place on upgrade space; Loot Drop Level to 3.
Stashed Treasure tokens cannot be lost.
carrying-and-stashing.clarification: Unstashed Dragon Gems still provide symbols for Dragon powers, and unstashed Treasures still count for Cave Omen collection.

dying.rule: Drop Treasure/Gems on tile; piece to board.
Killer gains bonus per Loot Drop Level (Knight Grit / Goblins Secrets or Rage / Dragon Power cards).
First turn after death: spawn Entrance.

upgrades.rule: Stash Treasure on upgrade space to gain upgrade immediately.
Cave Soporific Spores removes upgrade token but keeps stashed Treasure on board for victory.
upgrades.unnatural-evasion: First time each turn Thief is attacked by another player, roll Action die. On 4+, the attack fails and Thief may immediately move 1 space.
